about.heroTitle: We're building the platform AI specialists deserve
about.heroDesc: AI Marketplace was created because every existing platform takes 10–20% from specialists who already work hard to build the future. We said no to that model — and built something better.
about.v1Desc: Every product decision starts with one question: does this help specialists earn more and work better? We never take a cut of their income.
about.v2Desc: No hidden fees and no surprise charges. We take no commission at all, because the money moves directly between client and specialist — the platform never touches it.
about.v3Desc: AI talent is everywhere — not just in Silicon Valley. We're built for specialists in Moscow, Lagos, Jakarta, and São Paulo equally.
about.v4Desc: We're not a generic platform with an AI category bolted on. Every feature is designed for the specific way AI projects are scoped, priced, and delivered.
about.missionText: To make AI expertise accessible to every business in the world — and to ensure that the specialists who provide that expertise are fairly compensated, respected, and empowered to build extraordinary careers.
about.ctaDesc: Whether you're looking to hire AI expertise or offer your own — you're in the right place.
about.howDesc: Four steps from a brief to a finished project.
about.how1Desc: Describe the task, set a budget and a deadline. Takes a few minutes and costs nothing.
about.how2Desc: Specialists send a cover letter, their price and a timeline. You compare and ask questions.
about.how3Desc: Chat, files and progress live in one place. Payment terms are agreed between the two of you; the platform takes no part in the settlement.
about.how4Desc: Accept the work, settle up as agreed, and leave a review. We take 0% from the specialist.
about.trustDesc: What protects both sides of every deal.
about.trust1Desc: We are not a payment intermediary: you agree the terms and settle between yourselves. That is exactly why nothing is deducted from the specialist's fee.
about.trust2Desc: Email verification for everyone, identity and skill checks for top-tier specialists.
about.trust3Desc: A review can only be left after a completed project. It cannot be edited or bought.
about.trust4Desc: Any profile, project or message can be reported. We review every report within 48 hours.

why.heroTitle: The AI talent platform that actually works for you
why.heroDesc: Not another generic freelancing site with an AI category bolted on. Built from the ground up for the AI economy — no commission, and you deal directly with the person doing the work.
why.diffTitle: Why specialists and clients choose us
why.diffSubtitle: We built what we wished existed — a platform with no conflict of interest between specialists and the platform itself.
why.d1D: Upwork takes 10–20%. Fiverr takes 20%. FL.ru and Kwork take 10–20%. We take nothing. Every rouble or dollar the client pays goes to the specialist. No hidden deductions.
why.d2D: Because we don't skim your income, specialists here consistently earn more per project than on competing platforms — at the very same rate card.
why.d3T: Built for AI, not adapted to it
why.d3D: Every category, filter and matching rule is designed around AI skills — not repurposed from a generic freelancing platform.
why.d4D: From Silicon Valley to Bangalore, from Berlin to São Paulo. The interface speaks 12 languages, so people can work in their own.
why.d5T: You settle directly, we take nothing
why.d5D: The platform is not a payment intermediary. Client and specialist agree the terms and settle between themselves — which is precisely why our commission is zero and there is nothing to deduct.
why.d6D: Every profile shows the work behind it: portfolio, description, and reviews from clients who actually hired. Nothing here can be bought — there are no paid placements.
why.compareNote: * Toptal charges clients roughly a 40% markup over the specialist rate
why.t1Q: I paid Upwork 20% for years. AI Market takes nothing. Same clients, same work — I now earn a third more.
why.t2Q: Found a computer vision specialist in 48 hours. The category depth here is unmatched — finally a platform that actually understands AI work.
why.t3Q: It matters to us that project data isn't sitting in a bucket owned by a US megacorp. AI Market was the only serious option.

help.heroDesc: Answers to the most common questions. Can't find what you need? Write to us directly.
help.cardChatDesc: Sign in and use the built-in chat
help.q1: How do I create an account?
help.a1: Press “Sign up” in the top right corner. Choose your role — Client if you want to hire, Specialist if you are looking for work. Then register with Google or with your email and a password. You can also sign in by a link sent to your inbox, without a password at all.
help.q2: Can I switch between Client and Specialist?
help.a2: Yes. Once signed in, you can switch your role in settings. Many people use the platform as both — hiring for one project and working on another.
help.a3: Yes, completely free for clients and specialists alike. We take 0% commission on every transaction.
help.q4: Which countries can use AI Marketplace?
help.a4: The platform is open worldwide. Payments do not pass through it: the client and the specialist agree the method and the currency themselves and settle directly.
help.q5: How do I post a project?
help.a5: After signing in, go to Projects → New project. Describe the task, set a budget and choose fixed price or hourly billing. The project becomes visible to matching specialists straight away.
help.a6: You agree payment directly with the specialist — the method, the schedule, whether there is an advance. The platform is not involved in the settlement and takes no commission. Discuss the terms in the chat before work starts, so both sides have the same understanding on record.
help.q7: What if I am not happy with the work?
help.a7: Start by talking it through with the specialist in the chat — most cases end there. If you cannot agree, you can leave an honest review once the project is closed and report the profile. Since we are not part of the settlement, we cannot return money, so agree on stages and payment order before work begins.
help.a8: None at all. We take no commission and add no service charge. You pay the specialist directly, on the terms the two of you agreed.
help.q9: How much does AI Marketplace take from my earnings?
help.a9: Nothing. Our commission is 0%. If a client pays you $1,000, you receive $1,000. We earn from optional paid features for specialists, not from a cut of your work.
help.a10: Directly from the client, by whatever method you agreed — bank transfer, card, or anything else that suits you both. The platform does not hold your money and takes no cut. Agree the payment schedule before you start and put it in writing in the chat.
help.q11: How do I make my profile attract clients?
help.a11: Fill in every section: add a proper photo, write a clear bio, list your specific AI skills and upload portfolio work. Specialists with complete profiles get noticeably more invitations.
help.q12: Can I work with several clients at once?
help.a12: Yes, there is no limit on active projects. We do recommend being straight with clients about your availability when you take on new work.
help.q13: How do the two sides usually settle?
help.a13: However suits them: bank transfer, card, or an e-wallet. The settlement is between you directly, so the choice is yours. We recommend writing the agreed method into the chat before work begins.
help.q14: Does the platform guarantee the deal?
help.a14: No. We are not a payment intermediary and hold no funds, so we cannot guarantee a settlement. What we do give you is a way to judge who you are dealing with: verified profiles, ratings, reviews that can only be left after a completed project, and a chat history that remains as a record.
help.q15: How can I reduce the risk?
help.a15: Split the work into stages and settle stage by stage. Check the rating, the reviews and the portfolio before you start. Keep the discussion inside the platform chat — that history stays and helps if things go wrong. Report anyone who behaves badly.
help.q16: What currency are budgets shown in?
help.a16: Project budgets are given in US dollars as a common reference point. The actual currency you settle in is whatever the client and specialist agree between themselves.
help.q17: What if there is a conflict with the other side?
help.a17: Try to resolve it in the chat first. If that fails, report the profile or the project — we review every report within 48 hours and can restrict or block an account. We cannot return money, because the settlement never passes through us.
help.a18: Everyone passes email verification. Top-tier specialists also complete a skills assessment and identity check. Ratings and client reviews are public and cannot be edited.
help.q19: How do I report a user or a project?
help.a19: Use the “Report” button on any profile or project page, or write to trust@aimarketplace.io. We look into every report within 48 hours.
help.stillDesc: Our support team replies within 24 hours on business days.
